:::{#thm-bernoulli-loglik-general}

#### Log-likelihood of independent binary outcomes

Under the assumptions of @thm-bernoulli-lik-general,
the [log-likelihood](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-loglik) of $\vy$ is:

$$
\llik(\vpi)
= \sumin \llik_i(\pi_i)
= \sumin \paren{y_i \logf{\pi_i} + (1-y_i) \logf{1-\pi_i}}
$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-loglik-general.

:::
